soilHealthPractices: Maintain soil organic carbon above 0.8% using 5 tonnes/acre well-decomposed FYM or enriched compost

compostingMethods: NADEP Aerobic Composting: Brick tank (10ft x 5ft x 3ft) with staggered air holes, layering agricultural waste, dung slurry, and soil

keyActivities: Sow 100g hybrid seeds (e.g. Shivam / PKM-1) in 98-cell pro-trays using sterilized coco-peat
Maintain under 50% shade net to prevent whitefly vector entry and Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV)
Drench with Pseudomonas fluorescens (2g/L) on Day 12 to prevent damping-off
stages.waterManagement: Fine rose-can watering twice daily; reduce watering 3 days before transplanting for seedling hardening.
stages.nutrientRegime: Foliar spray of 19:19:19 (3g/L) at Day 15 and Day 20.
stages.pestMonitoring: Inspect underside of leaves for whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci); install yellow sticky cards.
stages.criticalAlert: Never use field soil in pro-trays to prevent soil-borne Fusarium wilt.

keyActivities: Form broad bed and furrows (120 cm width) with 40 cm walking path
Lay 16mm inline drip lateral lines with 40 cm dripper spacing (2 LPH)
Transplant 25-day-old vigorous seedlings at 60 cm x 45 cm spacing during late afternoon
stages.waterManagement: Operate drip for 45 minutes immediately after planting; maintain root-zone moisture at 65-70%.
stages.nutrientRegime: Basal application of 10 tonnes/acre FYM + 50 kg DAP + 25 kg MOP incorporated during bed forming.
stages.pestMonitoring: Monitor for cutworms and flea beetles; spray neem oil 3% at Day 35.
stages.criticalAlert: Ensure soil is saturated before planting to avoid transplanting shock.

keyActivities: Erect bamboo or eucalyptus support poles (2m height) every 3m along the bed
Tie plants with plastic twine to prevent fruit contact with wet soil and soil-borne rot
Prune lower side suckers up to 20 cm from ground to maintain single/double main stem
stages.waterManagement: Drip irrigation 1.5 hours every alternate day based on soil tensiometer readings.
stages.nutrientRegime: Fertigation schedule through Venturi: 19:19:19 (4 kg/acre/week) + Calcium Nitrate (2 kg/acre/week).
stages.pestMonitoring: Install pheromone traps (5/acre) for Tomato Fruit Borer (Helicoverpa armigera) and Pinworm (Tuta absoluta).
stages.criticalAlert: Calcium deficiency causes Blossom End Rot (black sunken patch at fruit bottom). Maintain regular fertigation.

keyActivities: Foliar spray of Planofix (Alpha NAA @ 1 ml/4.5 L) or TNAU Tomato Special (2g/L) to prevent flower drop
Weekly inspection of fruit calyx for pinworm tunneling
Remove virus-infected plants showing leaf curling immediately to prevent field spread
stages.waterManagement: Consistent moisture is critical; erratic irrigation during fruit enlargement causes fruit cracking.
stages.nutrientRegime: Switch fertigation to high potassium: Potassium Nitrate 13:0:45 (5 kg/acre/week) for firm fruit wall and vibrant red color.
stages.pestMonitoring: Spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt @ 2g/L) or Emamectin benzoate (0.5g/L) for fruit borers.
stages.criticalAlert: Avoid excessive nitrogen which causes lush foliage and flower drop.

keyActivities: Harvest fruits at 'Breaker' or 'Pink' stage (slight yellowish-pink color at blossom end) for maximum shelf life
Harvest in plastic crates (avoid gunny bags) during early morning hours to retain freshness
Direct transport to Salem Suramangalam / Hasthampatti Uzhavar Sandhai or listing on Namma Vivasayi marketplace
stages.waterManagement: Light irrigation after every alternate picking to sustain late-season fruit sizing.
stages.nutrientRegime: Maintain Micronutrient foliar spray (Boron 1g/L) every 15 days.
stages.pestMonitoring: Inspect harvested fruits for fruit fly puncture; sort and grade into A-grade and B-grade.
stages.criticalAlert: Never harvest wet fruits; moisture promotes post-harvest bacterial soft rot.

harvestIndices: Breaker stage: 10% to 20% pink/yellow color at blossom end for distant transport
Firm texture with shiny skin and intact calyx
Average fruit weight: 70g to 90g for hybrid varieties
marketChannels: Salem Suramangalam Uzhavar Sandhai (Direct consumer retail)
Namma Vivasayi Direct Farmer-to-Customer Marketplace (Farm gate pickup & bulk delivery)

highlights: Pro-tray under shade net guarantees 95% seedling survival
Bamboo staking increases marketable yield by 35% and eliminates ground rot
Direct sales at Salem Uzhavar Sandhais eliminates commission agents

sourceExcerpt: Groundnut VRI 8 cultivation. Seed rate 125 kg kernels/ha. Gypsum 400 kg/ha at 45 DAS. Shelling percentage 72%. KVK Salem 0427-2422550.

keyActivities: Select bold, well-filled certified kernels of VRI 8 (55 kg/acre seed rate)
Treat with Trichoderma viride (@ 4g/kg) followed by Rhizobium culture (TNAU Gn-1 @ 50g/kg) using rice gruel
Shade dry treated seeds for 30 minutes before sowing
stages.waterManagement: Sow in moist seedbed following pre-monsoon showers or light sprinkler irrigation.
stages.nutrientRegime: Basal application of 5 tonnes FYM + 10 kg N + 20 kg P2O5 + 30 kg K2O per acre.
stages.pestMonitoring: Treat with Chlorpyrifos 20 EC (2 ml/kg seed) if termite history exists.
stages.criticalAlert: Never expose Rhizobium-inoculated seeds to direct sunlight.

keyActivities: Pre-emergence herbicide spray: Pendimethalin (1.0 L/acre) on Day 3 in moist soil
Hand hoeing and light weeding at Day 20
Ensure row spacing of 30 cm x 10 cm
stages.waterManagement: Irrigate at 10-12 day intervals if dry spell exceeds 15 days.
stages.nutrientRegime: Foliar spray of 0.5% Ferrous sulphate + 0.1% Citric acid at Day 25 if iron chlorosis (yellow leaves) appears.
stages.pestMonitoring: Monitor for Groundnut Leaf Miner (Aproaerema modicella); spray Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%).
stages.criticalAlert: Do not disturb soil after peg penetration starts on Day 35.

keyActivities: Mandatory Gypsum application: 160 kg/acre broadcasted around plant base on Day 45
Light earthing up to guide descending pegs into the loosened soil bed
Ensures calcium availability for pod filling and prevents blind nuts ('Pops')
stages.waterManagement: Crucial moisture phase: Pegging stage requires optimum soil moisture; apply life irrigation if rain fails.
stages.nutrientRegime: Gypsum provides 24% Calcium and 18% Sulphur essential for pod wall hardening and oil synthesis.
stages.pestMonitoring: Inspect for Tikka leaf spot (Cercospora); spray Mancozeb (2g/L) or Carbendazim (1g/L) if brown spots appear.
stages.criticalAlert: Failure to apply gypsum at 45 days results in empty pods with zero kernel development.

stages.stageName: Pod Development & Tikka Leaf Spot IPM
keyActivities: Foliar spray of TNAU Groundnut Rich (2 kg/acre) at Day 65 to maximize kernel weight
Maintain field bunds clean to prevent rodent tunneling and pod gnawing
stages.waterManagement: Maintain moderate moisture; waterlogging at this stage leads to pod rotting in soil.
stages.nutrientRegime: No soil nitrogen application; nodule bacteria supply sufficient nitrogen.
stages.pestMonitoring: Erect bird perches (10/acre) and install light traps for Spodoptera litura moths.
stages.criticalAlert: Waterlogging causes seed germination inside the pod before harvest.

keyActivities: Check maturity signs: Yellowing of foliage, inner pod shell turns dark brown/black, kernels separate easily
Lift plants using tractor groundnut digger or manual pulling in moist soil
Strip pods mechanically and sun-dry on clean tarpaulins for 4-5 days until moisture drops below 9.0%
stages.waterManagement: Give light harvest irrigation 2 days prior to digging if soil is hard and dry.
stages.pestMonitoring: Dry pods thoroughly to <9% moisture to prevent carcinogenic Aflatoxin (Aspergillus flavus) contamination in storage.
stages.criticalAlert: Storing pods with >10% moisture causes fungal mold and zero mandi price realization.

harvestIndices: Leaves turn yellow and begin to shed
Inner surface of the pod shell displays prominent dark veins and brownish-black color
Moisture of dried pods is below 9.0% (rattling sound when shaken)
marketChannels: Salem Regulated Market Committee (Shevapet & Attur yards via e-NAM)
Namma Vivasayi Direct Marketplace (Direct kernel & seed sale)

highlights: VRI 8 offers high shelling percentage (72%) and 49% oil content
Gypsum application at Day 45 guarantees 25% higher pod weight
Direct e-NAM sale at Salem Regulated Market avoids middleman brokerage

keyActivities: Sprout 12 kg certified seeds per acre using Pseudomonas fluorescens (10g/kg)
Prepare 100 sq.m raised bed on polythene sheet with sieved soil:FYM mix
Sow sprouted seeds uniformly and cover with paddy straw for 48 hours
stages.waterManagement: Keep soil moist with rose-can for first 5 days; maintain 1 cm thin water film from Day 6 to 18.
stages.nutrientRegime: Top-dress with 0.5% urea solution at Day 10 if seedlings look pale.
stages.pestMonitoring: Watch for armyworm and leaf folder; install bird perches.
stages.criticalAlert: Do not let nursery bed dry to avoid seedling wilting.

keyActivities: Puddle field twice and level perfectly with wooden levelling board
Transplant 18-day-old mat seedlings using 4-row ride-on transplanter (30x15 cm spacing, 2-3 seedlings/hill)
Apply pre-emergence Butachlor (1.0 L/acre) at Day 3 after planting
stages.waterManagement: Maintain 2 cm standing water during transplanting; transition to Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD).
stages.nutrientRegime: Basal application: 5 tonnes FYM + 25 kg DAP + 15 kg MOP + 10 kg Zinc sulphate per acre.
stages.pestMonitoring: Scout for yellow stem borer egg masses; spray Azadirachtin (Neem 1% @ 2 ml/L) if ETL is reached.
stages.criticalAlert: Never apply Zinc sulphate directly mixed with DAP to prevent insoluble zinc phosphate precipitation.

keyActivities: Install perforated PVC 'Pani Pipe' (20 cm depth) in field to monitor water table
Irrigate only when water level drops 15 cm below soil surface (saves 30% irrigation water)
Operate cono-weeder twice between rows at Day 30 and Day 45 to incorporate weeds and aerate roots
stages.waterManagement: Strict AWD water management until panicle initiation stage.
stages.nutrientRegime: First top dressing at active tillering: 25 kg Urea + 10 kg Neem coated urea.
stages.pestMonitoring: Inspect leaf sheaths for Sheath Blight (Rhizoctonia solani); avoid high nitrogen doses.
stages.criticalAlert: Ensure field is flooded during panicle initiation (Day 70).

keyActivities: Maintain 3 cm to 5 cm constant water layer from boot leaf stage through 100% flowering
Foliar spray of 1% Potassium chloride (MOP) during terminal drought stress
Erect T-shaped bird perches (15/acre) for predatory birds
stages.waterManagement: Keep continuous standing water (5 cm) during 10-day flowering window to prevent sterile spikelets.
stages.nutrientRegime: Final top dressing: 15 kg Urea + 15 kg MOP per acre at panicle initiation.
stages.pestMonitoring: Watch for Brown Plant Hopper (BPH) at plant base; maintain alleyways (30 cm every 2m).
stages.criticalAlert: Drying field during flowering leads to chaffy, empty grains.

keyActivities: Completely drain water from field 10 days before anticipated harvest date to harden soil
Harvest when 85% of grains in panicles turn straw golden yellow using track combine harvester
Thresh, winnow, and sun-dry on clean drying yards to 14.0% FAQ moisture standard
Reserve appointment token for direct weighing at nearest TNCSC Direct Purchase Centre (DPC)
stages.waterManagement: Zero irrigation during final 12 days before machine entry.
stages.pestMonitoring: Protect dried bagged paddy from stored grain pests using dry neem leaves.
stages.criticalAlert: TNCSC DPC automatically rejects paddy if moisture exceeds 17.0%.

harvestIndices: Over 85% of grains in upper and middle panicles turn golden yellow
Hard dough stage when grain cannot be crushed between thumbnail and finger
Grain moisture at FAQ standard (14.0% to 15.0%)

highlights: Withstands up to 15 days of complete flood submergence without plant mortality
AWD water saving technique reduces methane emission and water consumption by 30%
Direct DPC yard linkage guarantees MSP transfer directly to farmer bank accounts

description.ta: சேலம் மாநகரம் மற்றும் புறநகரில் உள்ள 11 உழவர் சந்தைகளில் விவசாயிகள் காய்கறிகளை நேரடியாக பொதுமக்களுக்கு விற்கும் முறை.

institution: Department of Agricultural Marketing and Agri Business, Salem
sourceExcerpt: Uzhavar Sandhais in Salem District. Locations: Suramangalam, Hasthampatti, Dadagapatti, Ammapet, Attur, Mettur, Jalakandapuram, Edappadi. Free transport in government buses, free weighing scales.

contact.address: Office of DDAM, Collectorate Compound, Salem - 636 001
contact.verificationNote: Institutional contact of Deputy Director of Agricultural Marketing Salem.

tradingWorkflow: 1. Farmer obtains Uzhavar Sandhai Identity Card with photo from Assistant Director of Horticulture/Agriculture
2. Early morning arrival (5:00 AM to 6:30 AM) with freshly harvested vegetables and fruits
3. Free transport of produce baskets allowed in state transport buses
4. Allotment of free stall and certified electronic balance by Market Administrative Officer
5. Fair prices determined daily at 6:00 AM (average of wholesale + 20% consumer benefit) displayed on prominent LED price board
6. Direct retail cash or UPI sales directly to consumers until 12:00 PM; zero stall fee, zero middleman commission
tradingWorkflowTa: 1. தோட்டக்கலை அலுவலரிடம் உழவர் சந்தை அடையாள அட்டை பெறுதல்
2. அதிகாலை 5:00 மணி முதல் 6:30 மணிக்குள் விளைபொருட்களுடன் சந்தைக்கு வருதல்
3. அரசு பேருந்துகளில் விவசாயிகளின் விளைபொருட்களை இலவசமாக எடுத்துச்செல்லும் வசதி
4. இலவச விற்பனை மேடை மற்றும் துல்லிய எலக்ட்ரானிக் தராசு பெறுதல்
5. அன்றைய விலைப்பட்டியல் பலகையில் அறிவிக்கப்படும் விலையில் பொதுமக்களுக்கு நேரடியாக விற்பனை செய்தல்
qualityAssayingParameters: Freshness and harvest on previous evening or early morning
Hygienic sorting, grading, and free from rotten or insect-damaged produce
Zero chemical color or wax coating allowed
directMarketMeta.disputeResolutionDesk: Administrative Officer (AO), Uzhavar Sandhai Control Room
buyerLinkageChannels: Salem urban households and daily consumers
Local restaurants and small catering businesses

highlights: 11 functional Uzhavar Sandhais in Salem district (Suramangalam, Hasthampatti, Dadagapatti, Attur, etc.)
Free bus transport for farmers carrying produce baskets
Farmers realize 20% higher price while consumers save 15% compared to commercial retail shops

title.en: AgriBharat Direct Farm Gate & WhatsApp Order-Request Protocol
title.ta: அக்ரிபாரத் நேரடி பண்ணை விற்பனை & வாட்ஸ்அப் முன்பதிவு வழிகாட்டல்

description.en: Operating guidelines for registered farmers to list available harvests on AgriBharat marketplace, handle customer order requests, arrange farm gate pickups, and accept digital UPI payments.
description.ta: விவசாயிகள் தங்களின் விளைபொருட்களை அக்ரிபாரத் செயலியில் பட்டியலிட்டு, வாடிக்கையாளர் முன்பதிவுகளை ஏற்று பண்ணை வாசலில் விற்கும் நேரடி முறை.

institution: AgriBharat Agricultural Direct Marketplace Framework
sourceExcerpt: Direct Farmer-to-Customer peer discovery protocol. Verified farmer telephone contacts, 0% platform commission, farm gate collection, and digital UPI settlement.

contact.address: Kisan Call Centre & Agri Marketing Directorate, Chennai - 600 032
contact.verificationNote: State Kisan Call Centre helpline 1800-425-1661.

directMarketMeta.marketType: Peer-to-Peer Farmer-to-Buyer Direct Discovery (Farm Gate Pickup / Local Delivery)
tradingWorkflow: 1. Farmer logs into AgriBharat app and clicks 'List My Produce'
2. Enters crop name, variety, quantity, unit, farm gate asking price, harvest date, and fulfillment modes
3. Customer discovers listing on marketplace and submits order request with quantity and delivery preference
4. Farmer receives real-time order alert with buyer name, phone, and estimated total price
5. Farmer confirms order request and connects directly on WhatsApp / phone to schedule collection or delivery
6. Direct UPI or cash payment directly between buyer and farmer with zero middleman deductions
tradingWorkflowTa: 1. அக்ரிபாரத் செயலியில் விளைபொருள் பெயர், அளவு, விலை மற்றும் அறுவடை தேதியை பதிவிடுதல்
2. நுகர்வோர் பட்டியலை பார்த்து தேவையான அளவை முன்பதிவு செய்தல்
3. விவசாயிக்கு உடனடி ஆர்டர் தகவல் மற்றும் வாங்குபவரின் தொலைபேசி எண் பகிரப்படுதல்
4. விவசாயி ஆர்டரை உறுதிசெய்து வாட்ஸ்அப் மூலம் பண்ணை முகவரியை பகிர்ந்து விநியோகம் செய்தல்
5. 0% கமிஷன் - முழுப் பணமும் நேரடியாக உழவருக்கே கிடைக்கிறது
qualityAssayingParameters: Truthful disclosure of harvest date and drying moisture
Clear mention of whether produce is certified organic or conventional
Accurate weighing in presence of buyer during farm gate collection
directMarketMeta.disputeResolutionDesk: Community Moderation & Admin Verification Review Desk
buyerLinkageChannels: Urban families seeking clean heritage rice and cold-pressed oils

highlights: 0% commission - 100% of the sale value reaches the farmer directly
Enables forward booking even before harvest date
Automatic bilingual presentation in Tamil and English
